SharedFlowBundle.name: ISAM-SAML-Light
SharedFlowBundle.Description: Type 1: "light" SAML. No bearer token at all -- the client certificate is the only identifying attribute, sent as AdditionalContext alongside client IP/UA (no wsse:Security, no wst:OnBehalfOf, since there's no token to put in either). Calls the shared ISAM-Common-* building blocks for the actual ISAM callout, signature validation, compression, and header-setting; see the top-level README for the full architecture.
